jobs.description: 실거래 kind Gold (root ADR-0350, ADR-0371; scripts/ops/gold-panel-rebuild.sh parcel-real-transaction): gold.parcel_real_transaction from silver.real_transaction, every deal placed again from its address and lot through the one place-identity resolver (never the Silver's pnu), daily at 09:50, as the 공매 kind's Gold: its Silver loads hourly, and an input-started Gold would wait in the spark pool behind every job within 20 of those hourly cycles; a run whose inputs did not move past the pins the current Gold recorded does nothing. It recomputes only the PNUs of the 법정동s a change reaches (the deals the load appended, both codes of a changed code pair through views.changed_codes, changed parcels, registers, owners and lineage, and the 법정동s whose window lost a month) and merges them; nothing rebuilds it whole. Its own job because an own-producer kind is never a table of `kinds` (root ADR-0287 §9). by_pnu_parcel_real_transaction_bake bakes its commit.
jobs.memory_measured: no memory peak logged 2026-10-18..11-08 (no cap, so no memory accounting); sized as the script foundation-gold-panel-rebuild.service runs (307M measured, 57 runs); Spark runs in its own capped container; systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap

open_exception.why: The first full build did not fit one unit and its growth will not either. Measured 2026-11-12 (12,094,440 rows from 13.5 million Silver deals): 17 시도 shards 8,309 s (the longest 963 s) after 233 s of inputs, then the commit 2,447 s (overwrite-diff 1,180 s, overwrite 1,268 s): about 11,000 s against the 9,000 s limit. The run of 10:23Z staged every shard and was stopped at 9,008 s in its commit; the next (13:01Z, the cut-over's gold step) read the stages back in 406 s and committed at 14:00:40Z. The build is staged by its plan (Stages, root ADR-0440), so a stopped run loses only the step in flight; but after the lane's first publish nothing starts the second unit before the next day's schedule (a retry would hold the whole spark pool twice in every other job's wait bound, job_specs.pool_starvation) (root ADR-0605 removed that bound; the limit stays), and the first unit ends as a timeout. The four earlier runs (1,921 s to 2,994 s) failed on driver memory before #1346 and #1361. No changed-keys run has been measured yet: the first is the schedule's of 2026-11-13 09:50Z.
open_exception.tracked_by: docs/roadmap/production-readiness.md (수집 run 당 상한): the build ends at a stage boundary by itself (a deadline pointer, as ADR-0391's Silver refresh) or leaves Spark with the Gold that moves to DuckDB (root ADR-0559); measure the changed-keys run after 2026-11-13 09:50Z and state it here

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

jobs.description: 실거래 kind Gold as a table of appended row versions (root ADR-0350, ADR-0371, ADR-0564 §6; scripts/ops/gold-versions-build.sh parcel-real-transaction → publisher build-parcel-real-transaction-versions): gold.parcel_real_transaction_versions, computed by DuckDB inside the publisher and appended as the keys whose digest changed (a removal marker for a key that left), each commit one version_seq. It is a stage of the shared versions build (kind_versions_build, root ADR-0615 §7): a deal has no PNU before it is placed, so the stage reads its inputs itself, each row once under its own 시군구 and once under every other 시군구 a code pair, a served form or the lineage links it to (the linked group; 72 시군구 in 32 groups, measured 2026-11-24), and the shared build shows it one 시군구 at a time; it keeps the documents whose PNU lies there (real_transaction_versions_stage). A 시도 is its own commit. While the lane serves gold.parcel_real_transaction it is that table's shadow: it reads the input pins and served edition its foundation-gold-build tag commit recorded, so the takeover check compares the two engines over one set of inputs; its first build holds every key. Nothing to do when its inputs, the served parcel edition and its code (with the build month every document names) are the base commit's; otherwise only the 시군구 whose rows moved (and the ones that read them) are rebuilt, and only the changed keys are appended. It starts on its inputs, as every versions build does: while it shadows, what it builds moves with the replaced table's build pins, and that build's commit (gold_parcel_real_transaction_rebuild, 09:50) is one of its inputs. Its fallback schedule, every two hours from 00:40, starts it even when no input moved: a first build longer than one run keeps the 시도 it committed (the table says which), and the next run builds the rest. Nothing reads it until the lane's takeover PR names it as the lane's gold_table.
jobs.open_files_measured: 2026-11-23 13:44Z..22:51Z: 11 runs of 11 failed at systemd's default soft limit 1024 with DuckDB's "Too many open files" while reading the spool back (1,790 parquet files: 7 tables of 250 to 263 시군구). DuckDB 2.0.0 opens a glob's files ahead of the scan (measured on a 260-file table of the same layout, 8 threads: 340 to 450 handles above the idle process for one table, 530 for the seven in one query; a partitioned write holds under 10), beside the lakehouse connections the run keeps. 65536 is 36 per spooled file, under systemd's hard limit 524288; systemd reports no open-files peak, so it is sized from the file count, not from a peak.
jobs.memory_measured: not measured: no run yet (new job). 8G is the template's, the cap of every foundation-gold-versions@ instance; the shared build holds one 시도's rows and builds one 시군구 of them at a time, and the publisher gives DuckDB three fifths of what the unit has left under MemoryHigh (MEMORY_SHARE), so DuckDB spills before the cap. The first shadow run's systemd memory peak replaces this text

first_run.estimated_from: computed, not measured: the first shadow build is whole, about 9,500 s of placing and writing (W81c's 2026-11-21 4-thread verdict: 세종·대전·울산·제주·대구, 1,570,597 deals, 769,542 rows in 750 s, scaled by deals to the nation's 19,936,743) plus the spool's one read of each input. It goes on across runs: each 시도 is its own commit, a run the unit's hour ends keeps the 시도 it committed and the next run builds the rest, from the replaced build's 09:50 commit at least one run every two hours (its fallback schedule; an input's change starts one sooner). Not measured on the shared build yet. Later runs build only the 시군구 whose rows moved.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved or a new build month began. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

jobs.description: Reflect each new Gold snapshot of gold.parcel_real_transaction (the own-producer 실거래 kind, root ADR-0371) in R2 by-PNU serving (scripts/ops/by-pnu-serving-bake.sh parcel-real-transaction), as section packs (root ADR-0147, ADR-0193 §9): a change set decides a create-only patch, a reflect-only manifest or a full new generation, exactly as the panel bake does per lane. Its own job, as every own-producer kind's (root ADR-0303 §2): a slow national parcel re-bake in by_pnu_serving_bake never holds it. Nothing to do until the operator's first pack-only publish of the lane (root ADR-0190). Started when gold_parcel_real_transaction_rebuild commits a new snapshot, and at 10:50 as the fallback (root ADR-0171); each run's containers are its own one-offs (scripts/guard/batch-containers-are-run-scoped.sh). Two slots and MemoryMax=5G, the public-auction bake's bound: a scheduled run patches the parcels of the 법정동s a day's deals changed, and the lane's whole generation is the operator's cut-over bake (root ADR-0190), not this job's. Two slots, as the ownership bake, so it never runs beside both the panel bake and another 5G bake (root ADR-0138).

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the parcel-ownership bake, the same by-pnu-serving-bake.sh: 636 s for 39,396,906 documents (2026-11-05, its cut-over's bake step); the lane bakes at most one document per served parcel (39,861,511), so 1,500 s, more than twice it; before the lane's first publish, which waits for whole history (root ADR-0350 §6), a run is `nothing to do: not cut over yet`

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

assets.title: 필지 실거래 by-PNU 표
assets.description: PNU마다 그 필지로 이어진 실거래(12종, 해제 포함)와, 공장용지·창고용지 필지면 같은 법정동의 공장창고 거래 새 20건, 법정동의 12개월 건수·m²당 금액 사분위를 담는 데이터 종류 표(루트 ADR-0350, ADR-0371). 매 빌드 원천 주소·지번에서 정본 해석기로 다시 잇고, 바뀐 법정동만 다시 계산한다.

assets.title: 필지 실거래 by-PNU 묶음 파일
assets.description: gold.parcel_real_transaction 의 PNU 문서를 법정동 묶음으로만 굽는다. 필지 호스트의 Worker 가 /parcels/real-transaction/by-pnu/ 경로로 서빙한다(루트 ADR-0193, ADR-0371). 첫 발행은 운영자의 묶음 전용 관문을 거치고, 산업용 세 종의 이력이 다 차기 전에는 거부된다.

assets.title: 실거래 지역 통계
assets.description: (데이터셋, 법정동·시군구, 계약 달 또는 빌드 달 앞 12개월)마다 거래 수·해제 수와 해제되지 않은 거래의 m²당 금액(대지·계약면적, 토지 아닌 것은 건물면적) 사분위를 만원으로 담는다(루트 ADR-0350 4항, ADR-0371). 거래의 현재 법정동으로 세므로 코드 변경을 따라간다. 실거래 종류와 한 실행에서 같은 거래로 만들고, 변경이 닿은 시군구만 다시 계산해 키로 합친다.

assets.title: 필지 실거래 by-PNU 표(판을 쌓는 표)
assets.description: gold.parcel_real_transaction 과 같은 칸에 version_seq·row_state 를 더한, 바뀐 PNU 의 행만 덧붙이는 표다(루트 ADR-0561, ADR-0564 §1·§2). 현재 행은 PNU 마다 version_seq 가 가장 큰 행이고 row_state 가 removed 면 그 PNU 는 없다. 그냥 조회하면 옛 판과 삭제 표시가 보인다. 발행기 안의 DuckDB 가 계산하고 발행기가 추가 커밋으로 붙인다. 레인이 옛 표를 굽는 동안은 그 표의 그림자다(옛 표 빌드 태그의 입력 핀으로 짓는다, 루트 ADR-0564 §6): 판정(옛 표의 행과 이 표의 현재 행이 값으로 같다) 뒤에 레인 줄의 gold_table 이 이 표로 옮겨진다.

assets.title: 실거래 지역 통계(판을 쌓는 표)
assets.description: gold.real_transaction_region_stats 와 같은 칸에 version_seq·row_state 를 더한, 바뀐 (데이터셋, 지역, 기간) 행만 덧붙이는 표다(루트 ADR-0564 §6-9). 독자가 실거래 Gold 의 생산자 하나라 레인 스위치 없이 새 생산자와 함께 태어난다. 아직 쓰는 작업이 없다.

dependencies.description: 자기 생산자를 가진 종류(루트 ADR-0287 9항, ADR-0371): 현재 거래 행을 주소·지번에서 매 빌드 다시 이어 PNU 문서로 묶는다. Silver 의 pnu·법정동은 읽지 않는다. 적재가 덧붙인 행의 법정동만 다시 계산한다.
코드 쌍으로 옛 코드의 거래를 현재 코드로 옮긴다. 바뀐 쌍의 두 코드 아래 법정동만 다시 계산한다(views.changed_codes, 루트 ADR-0329 3항).
거래의 시군구 주소를 가장 새 스냅숏의 법정동 이름으로 코드에 잇는다. 이름이 바뀐 코드의 법정동만 다시 계산한다.
비교 거래를 싣는 지목(공장용지·창고용지)과 가린 지번 추정의 면적·용도지역을 읽는다(루트 ADR-0351).
가린 지번 추정의 사용승인 연도·연면적을 읽는다(루트 ADR-0351).
가린 지번 추정의 소유권 변동을 읽는다(루트 ADR-0351, ADR-0370).
계약 뒤 분할·합병된 필지의 거래를 계보로 현재 필지에 옮긴다(공매와 같은 placed).
거래를 주소의 현재 법정동과 계약 달로 묶는다. 적재가 덧붙인 거래의 시군구만 다시 계산한다.
코드 쌍으로 옛 코드의 거래를 현재 코드의 통계로 옮긴다. 바뀐 쌍의 두 코드가 걸친 시군구만 다시 계산한다(views.changed_codes).
문서의 region 은 그 법정동의 앞 12개월 통계 행이다(같은 실행의 같은 계산).
행마다 그 필지의 안정 place_id 를 싣는다(루트 ADR-0483, ADR-0288 §5): 다리의 필지 단위 열린 기간(없으면 마지막 기간)의 id. 짓는 PNU 의 다리 행만 읽는다. 본번 묶음으로 이은 행은 묶음 필지들의 place_id 를 main_lot_group_place_ids 로 싣는다(루트 ADR-0405).
발행이 덧붙인 변경 이력 행의 코드(옛·새)만 다시 계산한다(루트 ADR-0483): 이력은 append-only 라 고정한 스냅숏 뒤에 붙은 행만 읽는다.
the 실거래 Silver's current rows, read whole once (history_coverage is defined over all of it)
the served edition's parcels, the PNUs a deal is placed on
지목·면적·용도지역 the masked-lot inference and the comparables read
the main buildings the masked-lot inference reads
the ownership changes the masked-lot inference reads
a deal on a retired parcel follows the lineage to its current successors
an address's code carried to the current one (the crosswalk), and 시군구 a pair links built together
an address's 법정동 looked up in the newest code snapshot
each parcel's place id through the one reader place_id_join::place_ids_sql
the replaced table: while the lane serves it, the shadow is built at the pins its build tag recorded (root ADR-0564 §6)
레인의 넘겨받기 PR 이 종류 줄의 gold_table 을 이 표로 바꾸면(판정 equal 뒤, 루트 ADR-0564 §6) 레인의 굽기가 이 표의 현재 행을 읽는다. 그때까지 아무도 읽지 않는 그림자다.

parcel-real-transaction.first_publish_waits_for_history_reason: root ADR-0479, superseding ADR-0371 §5: the lane's first cutover (by-pnu-pack-operator.sh <lane> cutover) is refused until silver.real_transaction's commits record the recent history (recent_history_months of rt-molit-real-transaction.contract.json, 36 whole months to the last whole month) of the datasets the document computes windows from: 공장창고 (the comparables, 36 months, and the region statistics) and 토지 (the region statistics, 12 months), REGION_DATASETS of real_transaction_silver_to_gold.py; a window short of months would show wrong counts and medians with nothing to say so (scripts/ops/serving_history_readiness.py). The older history of every dataset is not waited for: the document says from when each dataset not held whole is held (real_transaction.coverage) and the panel shows 'YYYY-MM 이후'. Measured 2026-11-11: both whole (251 months each)

revisions.reason: the first document: a parcel's 실거래 deals of all 12 datasets, the 공장창고 comparables of its 법정동 and the 법정동's 12-month counts and m² price quartiles, from silver.real_transaction placed again on every build; the Gold JSON column as written, nulls included

real_transaction.coverage, an optional array: the datasets whose history is not held whole yet, each with the month it is held from, so the lane publishes while the history fills newest first and the screen says from when (root ADR-0479)
